answer: In PoA, trust propagates as a bounded random walk over the attestation graph: each step discounts weakly supported transitions, so voting influence follows stationary mass rather than identities. A sybil cluster can gain weight only through its boundary; if that external cut has low conductance, min-cut transitivity bounds cap escaping mass and therefore its aggregate voting power. The raven, quill, and signal attestations remain constrained by this spectral bottleneck.
